chunks.text: Today we will talk about FESS.
FESS is a city in Morocco, North Africa.
It is famous for its old city, markets, and culture.
The city is full of history, colors, and life.
People enjoy walking in narrow streets and exploring traditional shops.
Let's explore FESS together.
Part 2.
Where is FESS?
FESS is in northern Morocco, near the Middle Atlas Mountains.
The city is built around hills and rivers.
FESS is an important cultural and religious center.
It is the second largest city in Morocco, after Casablanca.
Part 3.
A short history of FESS.
FESS is very old.
It was founded in the 9th century.
It became a center for learning, trade, and religion.
Many schools, mosques, and palaces were built over the centuries.
FESS is known for its traditional culture and historical landmarks.
Part 4.
FESS Medina.
The Medina is the old part of the city.
It has narrow streets, markets, and traditional houses.
People sell spices, clothes, leather, and crafts.
Walking in the Medina is like traveling back in time.
The Medina is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Part 5.
Landmarks of FESS.
FESS has many landmarks.
All -Karawian University is one of the oldest universities in the world.
The boat in Naniya Madrasa is a beautiful school with decorations and art.
You can also see old gates, fountains, and mosques.
Each place shows the history of FESS.
Part 6.
Food and FESS.
Food and FESS is tasty and traditional.
People eat couscous, tagine, bread, and vegetables.
A popular dish is pastilla, a pastry with meat and almonds.
Street food is also popular.
Mint tea, dates, and sweets.
Food is an important part of life in FESS.
Part 7.
Markets and Suks.
FESS is famous for its markets called Suks.
People sell leather, ceramics, spices, and clothes.
Suks are colorful, busy, and full of life.
People enjoy shopping, tasting food, and taking photos.
Part 8.
Culture and People.
People in FESS are friendly and welcoming.
Many speak Arabic and French.
Family life is important.
People celebrate traditions, music, and festivals.
Culture is everywhere in food, clothes, music, and art.
Part 9.
Religion in FESS.
Most people in FESS are Muslim.
Mosques are everywhere.
Calls to prayer are heard five times a day.
People visit mosques to pray and celebrate religious festivals.
Religion is very important for daily life and traditions.
Part 10.
Nature Around FESS.
Nature is close to the city.
The Middle Atlas Mountains are nearby.
People hike, enjoy forests, and see rivers.
The climate is warm in summer and cool in winter.
Nature gives people a chance to relax and enjoy the outdoors.
Part 11.
Festivals in FESS.
FESS has many cultural festivals.
One famous festival is the FESS Festival of World Sacred Music.
People enjoy music, dance, and art from different countries.
Festivals make the city lively and full of culture.
Part 12.
Goodbye from FESS.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
I am Emilie.
FESS is a city of history, culture, food, and markets.
You can walk in the Medina, visit old schools and mosques, taste traditional food, and explore the mountains.
It is a city full of life, tradition, and beauty.
I hope you can visit FESS one day and feel its charm.
